name: Allow + empty NotAction complement (masked full-admin)
note: IAM-1508 / S2-guard-parity regression. An Allow whose only action element is a present-but-empty NotAction ([]) excludes NOTHING under AWS semantics, so it grants EVERY action - a full-admin grant. The engine models it as granting nothing; the shared engine must mark coverage INCOMPLETE (EMPTY_NOTACTION_COMPLEMENT) so neither the browser (analyze) nor the CLI (scan) reports a clean pass. Previously caught only by the CLI adapter (browser fail-open).
